reason: The README clearly describes a dsh plugin that integrates the CPA service as a chat provider, supports model synchronization and optional local CPA startup, and presents execution and usage status.

summaries.zh: 将 CPA 服务接入 dsh，提供聊天请求代理、模型同步、可选的本地 CPA 启动以及执行和用量状态展示。
summaries.en: Connects CPA to dsh as a chat provider with model synchronization, optional local CPA startup, and execution and usage status displays.

capabilities: Registers a CPA provider for chat completion requests
Synchronizes available models from the CPA API
Connects to an existing CPA endpoint using configured credentials
Can launch a local CPA executable and inject generated provider credentials
Stores plugin settings and execution records locally
Queries CPA management endpoints for usage and account summaries
Displays CPA status and usage information in the user interface
